name: Buffro: Ranked Workout Tracker
description:
LOG EVERY LIFT. SCAN EVERY MEAL. SEE YOUR PROGRESS.

Buffro brings workout tracking, nutrition, an AI fitness coach, Strength Ranks, and body progress into one focused app. Walk into the gym with a plan, log without losing momentum, and know what to improve next.

TRAIN WITH A PLAN
• Start from scratch or follow your own routine or program
• Log sets, reps, weight, RPE/RIR, supersets, single-side sets, warm-ups, and rest timers
• See previous performance and follow PRs, volume, estimated 1RM, and worked muscles
• Keep logging offline; Buffro syncs when you’re online again

MEET RO, YOUR AI COACH
• Generate workouts and multi-day routines for your goals, schedule, and equipment
• Ask questions mid-workout and swap exercises without breaking your flow
• Get practical guidance using your current session and training history

TRACK NUTRITION WITHOUT THE BUSYWORK
• Scan a meal photo for estimated calories and macros
• Search foods, scan barcodes, save meals, create recipes, and track protein
• Log water and fasting, set targets, and use calorie rollover or workout add-back

MAKE PROGRESS VISIBLE
• Climb Strength Ranks for exercises and muscle groups
• Review PRs, muscle distribution, readiness, streaks, charts, and monthly reports
• Compare progress photos, make timelapses, log measurements, and analyze body scans
• Connect Apple Health to sync body data and save finished workouts

STAY ACCOUNTABLE TOGETHER
Create private Workout Buddies groups, invite people you know, and compete
